shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Lift the modal above a darkened backdrop.

motion.name: row-reveal
motion.purpose: One subtle arrival for the first inventory rows.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Small lift and color shift on interactive controls.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 39px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: var(--forest, #173e32); color: #fffefa; font: 750 10px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, background .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease; } .ds-primary span { color: #f1c75b; font-size: 15px; } .ds-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #24583f; box-shadow: 0 5px 12px rgb(23 62 50 / 16%); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d39928; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary action that stays quiet until needed.
components.css: .ds-outline { min-height: 39px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid #d7dfd1; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #173e32; font: 750 10px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .16s ease, background .16s ease; } .ds-outline:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #eaf0e3; } .ds-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d39928; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search input
components.description: Ledger search field with a minimal rule.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; width: 170px; min-height: 35px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 9px; border-bottom: 1px solid #d9e0d3; color: #859183; font: 400 19px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #24352b; font: 400 10px 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #d39928; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active navigation item
components.description: Current location within the pantry workspace.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 12px 11px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #f1c75b; color: #12352b; font: 600 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav span { font-size: 20px; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d39928; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Expiry status chip
components.description: Written expiry timing paired with a supportive tint.
components.css: .ds-expiry { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 3px; background: #f8e4da; color: #9f492f; font: 750 9px/1.4 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The system pairs the practical clarity of a pantry ledger with the lively marks of a local harvest board. A dark forest rail anchors a pale working field; yellow, leaf green, and tomato red make the high-priority actions and expiry states easy to scan. System sans-serif lettering keeps the work legible on a shared device or small kitchen screen.

Lists stay flat and readable, with slim rules and honest sample-data labels doing more work than ornamental containers. The North Carolina produce illustration gives the expiry page an authored, recognizably food-centered opening without implying a live photograph or verified partnership.
keyCharacteristics: Forest-green navigation and harvest-yellow primary actions.
A date-first pantry ledger with plain-language expiry labels.
Compact crop illustrations and lightly ruled community boards.
Sample listings and local-only actions clearly identified as demonstrations.

rules.name: The Named-Status Rule
rules.body: Color reinforces the pantry state but never replaces its written label.

rules.name: The Plain-Label Rule
rules.body: Use sentence case for controls and human-readable dates; reserve uppercase labels for compact location and status metadata.

dos: Do keep expiry dates and next actions visible together.
Do label sample farms, pantry partners, destinations, and transactions as demo data.
Do show the chosen pickup or delivery destination before recording a claim.
Do make stock changes and notifications explicit local-demo events.
Do preserve keyboard focus and readable actions at every breakpoint.
donts: Don't imply live availability, verified partners, confirmed pickups, food transfers, or measured impact.
Don't use gradients or decorative metric rings in place of actual pantry content.
Don't hide the expiry workflow behind a board or modal.
